title: Debug Workbench: KV-cache Diff + Retry Hypothesis Canvas
creator: Priya Patel
description: Design and prototype a compact 'Debug Workbench' mode for the Redwood Console that helps engineers triage failed requests by combining a KV-cache diff viewer, a retry hypothesis canvas, and a concise timeline. Goal: let on-call and platform engineers form and validate hypotheses (bad cache state, corrupted prefix, stale model variant) within 2-3 minutes without leaving the Console.
background: Current error-analysis panels show raw payloads and full request traces but lack tools for comparing runtime state (KV cache snapshots, token prefixes, model variant metadata) across retries or time. Engineering has added APIs to export KV cache snapshots per request and to annotate retries with reason codes. This ticket synthesizes UI components to surface those artifacts in an actionable way.
design_goals: Surface differences between KV cache snapshots for consecutive retries (side-by-side diff with inline token context)
Expose 'retry hypothesis' flow: annotate a retry with a suspected cause, link to artifacts, and trigger a guided re-run in a staging environment
Keep initial surface compact (minimap + foldable panels) so it works inside the existing request inspector
Enable rapid navigation from timeline -> KV diff -> payload diff -> model metadata without context switching
constraints_and_tradeoffs: Bandwidth: full KV cache snapshots can be large; prototype uses sampled/trimmed snapshots and prefetched deltas to keep UI responsive
Security: KV snapshots may contain sensitive fragments; design includes a masking layer and audit metadata mandated by security team
Performance: diffing large token arrays client-side is expensive; recommend server-side diff endpoints for heavy workloads and point to them in the UI
Scope: initial rollout will support only text-generation flows; embeddings/streaming will be considered later
proposed_components: Timeline strip: compact horizontal view marking original request and subsequent retries with reason badges
KV Diff Viewer: side-by-side token-aligned diff, inline sparklines for hit/miss frequency, and 'jump to context' links into the payload inspector
Retry Hypothesis Canvas: lightweight card-based UI to attach a hypothesis, add tags (e.g., 'kv-eviction', 'quantization-glitch'), and link to a saved evaluation or PRD
Exploded Context Panel: stacked view showing request headers, model variant info, routing policy, and per-retry metadata
Minimap + Snapshots selector: small overview map to scrub across long token sequences and switch snapshot versions
engineering_notes: ENG: backend will expose GET /requests/:id/kv_snapshots?version=<n> returning sampled tokens + metadata
ENG: provide server-side diff: POST /diffs/kv with two snapshot ids to return compact ops for UI rendering
ENG: add audit tag to all snapshot fetches and store mask rules in config
Performance fallback: if snapshot size > 2MB, UI shows 'summarized diff' and a 'request full diff' action that runs server-side async
usability_plan: Round 1: internal dogfood with platform-oncall team (5 sessions, 30m each) to validate hypothesis flow
Round 2: 3 customer shadow sessions with mid-market PLG customers using Dedicated clusters
Metrics: time-to-first-hypothesis, number of context switches, accuracy of hypothesis after guided re-run
accessibility_considerations: Color-blind safe diff palettes, keyboard-first navigation for minimap scrubber, and semantic roles for timeline markers
acceptance_criteria: Prototype validated in at least 3 internal triage sessions with qualitative feedback recorded
Design tokens and components implemented in Console design system (token names included in Figma file)
Edge-case flows documented: large snapshot fallback, masked tokens, and permission checks
UX copy for hypothesis cards and audit tooltips reviewed and approved by legal/security
review_feedback: Noah Chen (Eng): Request server-side diff API to handle large snapshots; also add pagination for very long token sequences
Liam O'Connor (PM): Make retry reason badges filterable in the timeline and ensure they map 1:1 with backend reason codes
Maya Romero (Security): Confirm masking rules and include field-level redaction. Add explicit note that snapshots are stored for 7 days by default
Jasper Lee (Design): Reduce visual weight of minimap; prefer vertical stack for Exploded Context on narrow screens
decisions: Use sampled snapshots by default with explicit 'show full snapshot' action
Expose server-side diff endpoint to keep client CPU usage low
Mask tokens that match configured PII regex before rendering in diff view
Initial scope limited to text-generation requests and retries performed within 15 minutes
next_steps: Finalize Figma screens based on feedback (Ava)
Spec backend endpoints and contract with Eng (Ticket: ENG-41280)
Create lightweight demo script and recording for customer trials
